entities.name: Query CysN/CysC
observations: 633 aa; predicted molecular mass 69.9 kDa; theoretical pI 5.14; net charge at pH 7 approximately -23.
Fused architecture: N-terminal sulfate adenylyltransferase/GTPase module and C-terminal APS kinase module.
Pfam matches: GTP_EFTU positions 23-210, MMR_HSR1 positions 84-166, GTP-eEF1A_C positions 332-431, APS_kinase positions 461-609.
Closest reviewed homolog O50274 from Pseudomonas aeruginosa is 63.0% identical over 100% of the sequence.
Likely catalyzes sulfate activation to APS and then PAPS in sulfur assimilation; exact substrate specificity is inferred from close homologs.

entities.name: O50274 CysN/CysC
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa bifunctional CysN/CysC homolog; 63.0% identity and complete query coverage to the analyzed sequence.
Annotated with sulfate adenylyltransferase and APS kinase activities; forms ATP sulfurylase with CysD.
Annotated in sulfate assimilation and hydrogen sulfide biosynthesis.

entities.name: Sulfate to APS
observations: Candidate reaction: sulfate + ATP + H+ -> adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:18133.
In the CysN/CysC system, APS formation is coupled to GTP hydrolysis by the CysN module and ATP hydrolysis by CysD.

entities.name: APS to PAPS
observations: Candidate reaction: APS + ATP -> 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + ADP + H+; Rhea RHEA:24152.
This is the APS kinase reaction assigned to the C-terminal module.

entities.name: Sulfate assimilation
observations: The fused enzyme is associated with sulfur metabolism, sulfate assimilation, and hydrogen sulfide biosynthesis in close reviewed homologs.
